The Keep/banner/large-arch identity is present, but the extreme value contrast makes material mismatch dominate before those hero cues can read.
Timber scaffold and controlled damage survive but are too subordinate at gameplay scale to counter the washed-out massing.
Therefore Source07 is a clear geometry/source improvement but does not meet the integrated commercial HERO QUALITY BAR.
